summary: Canonical neighborhood interface over the D7 curvature and compactness layers. EpsilonApproximation is the one-step pointed epsilon-isometry datum (with refl, mono, comp and the two checked bridges to GHConvergenceData); CylinderInterface, CapInterface and SphereInterface are the metric interfaces of the three model spaces, recording the scale, the characteristic pair of points (pi r for the cylinder cross-section and the sphere, r for the cap boundary), the diameter bound pi r where the model is compact, and the scalar curvature normalizations 2/r^2 and 6/r^2. EpsilonNeck, EpsilonCap and EpsilonSpherical are the region data; CurvatureScaleDatum is the curvature normalization over the D7 curvature layer (an algebraic RiemannCurvatureData with a nondegenerate plane of sectional curvature 1/r^2); CanonicalNeighborhoodCertificate bundles the kind, the epsilon-model data, the curvature normalization and the metric noncollapsing shadow. Kernel-checked: the three model interfaces inhabit the certificate at their own scale for every epsilon >= 0 (cylinder/sphere for 0 < kappa <= pi, cap for 0 < kappa <= 1), the D7 so(3) model realizes the normalization at scale 2 (sec = 1/4), concrete line/interval witnesses inhabit the interfaces, all three kinds are non-vacuous, and the classification toy proves that the collapsed one-point model carries no certificate when 2 epsilon < r (with the general metric-size consequence r <= dist x y + 3 epsilon). The full Perelman canonical neighborhood theorem is a state-only Prop with a twelve-entry named missing-input ledger and six named blockers. No sorry/axiom/unsafe/native_decide/proof_wanted; all 95 audited declarations have standard axiom cones.

honest_boundary: No smooth Riemannian 3-manifold, Ricci flow, parabolic neighborhood, curvature tensor, injectivity radius, volume comparison or ancient-solution theory is constructed.
The model interfaces capture the metric-shadow features of the round cylinder, cap and sphere, not the smooth round models; the concrete witnesses are a line and two intervals.
CurvatureScaleDatum is an algebraic normalization over the D7 curvature layer, not the curvature of the region.
MetricNoncollapsing is a metric shadow of kappa-noncollapsing, not the volume noncollapsing theorem.
missingPerelmanCanonicalNeighborhood is a state-only Prop, never asserted as a theorem.
The classification toy excludes the collapsed model at a positive scale; it does not prove the full canonical neighborhood classification.
